title: Video by earn.edits
description:
📡History remembered her as one of Hollywood’s greatest stars 🎬

It almost forgot she helped invent the technology that connects the modern world 📡

This After Effects project transforms Hedy Lamarr’s story into a premium documentary-style motion graphics experience. Vintage Hollywood photography, wartime archives, engineering diagrams, patent illustrations, newspaper headlines 🎞️✨

Every photograph tells two stories. Every transition uncovers another chapter. Every composition challenges what history chose to remember 📰

Animated timelines. Frequency-hopping diagrams. Archival photography. Documentary callouts — a forgotten invention, explained in full 💡

For history, technology, and educational creators who want their content to feel as compelling as the story itself 

#earnedits #aftereffects #historycontent #retro_edit
